card.name: Just before the word system in patches
card.fires_on: The word just before "system" in transdermal patch labels, mainly the end of "transdermal" and small words like "one" or "the" that precede "transdermal system". It also fires on a few digits or punctuation inside numbers.

modes.label: End of transdermal
modes.description: The final piece of "transdermal" right before "system" in patch instructions.

modes.label: Words leading into transdermal system
modes.description: A small word that comes right before "transdermal system".
modes.example: Only wear<< one>> transdermal system at any time.

modes.label: Inside strength numbers
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a patch strength or suture size.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a patch label is about to say "transdermal system".
evidence: Only wear<< one>> transdermal system at any time.
